description: The chart illustrates the performance of various fine-tuning methods for different RoBERTa model sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning methods, labeled as LoRA, BitFit, S1-model, S4-model, and S5-model, while the vertical axis is labeled "Performance" and ranges from 86 to 88. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a fine-tuning method and containing two bars corresponding to the "base" and "large" RoBERTa model sizes, colored blue and orange, respectively. The "base" model performance values range from approximately 86.2 for BitFit to 87.3 for S5-model, while the "large" model performance values range from around 86.5 for BitFit to 88.1 for S5-model. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a comparison of the performance of different fine-tuning methods for the two RoBERTa model sizes.
